findings.title: Missing references interrupt the task
findings.observation: Network, provider organization, application and category are existing-record selects. New services cannot be started through the list when no network exists.
findings.consequence: A missing prerequisite sends the user into a different entity workflow before they can finish the service.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: inline network and provider creation retain a new service draft

findings.title: The detour commits an incomplete intention
findings.observation: In the synthetic production-component journey, Apply and continue created Reporting with no provider. Creating Platform Operations afterward did not link it back. Stay retained service text while the list had already changed to Organizations.
findings.consequence: The user must find the service again and finish a relationship they already intended.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: inline creation keeps explicit service defaults and parked relation-only intent

findings.title: New-service relationships are a second step
findings.observation: Support, organizational consumers and dependencies are rendered only after a service has an ID. A new-record form has no direct Cancel or Discard button.
findings.consequence: Users must first Add the service to work on its connections; leaving a draft uses indirect navigation.
current_evidence: src/domain/initial-service.test.ts: creates initial fields and relationships as one undoable aggregate

findings.title: References cannot be followed
findings.observation: Support, organizational consumer and dependency rows have plain labels. Related scalar fields are selects. Rows do not offer an Inspect action.
findings.consequence: Users must remember a name, change entity type or search, and reconstruct the previous context.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-navigation.spec.ts: reference peek preserves scalar and support draft, returns focus, and adds no history

findings.title: Reverse relationships are absent from details
findings.observation: Organization, application, category, network and CDS editors have no derived relationship sections. Service details list outgoing dependencies and consuming organizations, but no incoming dependent services.
findings.consequence: Users cannot answer who uses this service or where this organization, application or CDS is used from that record.
current_evidence: src/ui/relations.test.ts; e2e/connected-navigation.spec.ts: non-map references expose separate recorded reverse roles and application/category membership

findings.title: List, map and details have separate selection contexts
findings.observation: Selecting a list row opens the editor without a map-reveal call. Contextual Add service leaves the list category at Networks. Map view changes do not coordinate the active inspector.
findings.consequence: The three regions can describe different records or scopes, requiring the user to work out which one a command affects.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-navigation.spec.ts: accepted Back restores prior service, list filter and map framing without Undo

findings.title: Stay does not cancel Find's map effects
findings.observation: Current Find clears filters, changes the chain and centers the target before invoking the editor draft decision. The extracted-handler probe retained editor A after Stay while the map was already centered on B.
findings.consequence: A user can protect their draft but still lose the view they were using.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-navigation.spec.ts: Stay rejects a Find request before selection, filters, chain or framing change

findings.title: Find matches exact display strings
findings.observation: Find requires the qualified service label, returns false silently for a bare name, and selects the first matching network/CDS display name. The list search covers only the chosen entity type.
findings.consequence: Users need prior knowledge of type and label format; duplicate names can resolve to the wrong type.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-navigation.spec.ts: partial Find keeps duplicate services and cross-type names distinct with keyboard selection

findings.title: Projected context has an incomplete lifecycle
findings.observation: Projected inspection clears current editor identity. Ordinary refresh/reload return without it. Edit As-Is switches view and opens the baseline record without revealing it through any retained filter.
findings.consequence: Details can outlive their displayed projection; an intentionally opened baseline service can remain hidden on the map.
findings.evidence: Source inference; integrated journey still needed
current_evidence: e2e/connected-projection.spec.ts: View invalidation, planned-origin Undo, Edit As-Is and Back

findings.title: Dependency rows lose endpoint identity
findings.observation: The add picker includes a provider's network, but existing dependency rows omit it. The executed editor rendered two distinct Directory providers as identical Directory rows.
findings.consequence: The user cannot confidently inspect or remove the intended same-named provider from the row label.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: route edit stages with scalar changes and one Undo restores both; Cancel route writes nothing

findings.title: Routes require remove and re-add
findings.observation: An existing dependency has Remove only. The composer offers every CDS rather than candidates for the intended network pair. Final repository validation still refuses invalid changes.
findings.consequence: A route correction is cumbersome, and the UI offers choices that fail late.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: route edit stages with scalar changes and one Undo restores both; Cancel route writes nothing

findings.title: Map edges cannot be inspected
findings.observation: The map tap handler returns for non-node targets. There is no connection-level inspector for a direct edge or either segment of a CDS route.
findings.consequence: Users can see a line but cannot use it to inspect its endpoints, meaning or route.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-focus.spec.ts: both CDS segments open the same owning connection inspector without writing

findings.title: Control reconstruction loses working position
findings.observation: Relationship changes reconstruct the relation subtree. A focused support selector and a focused selected list button both became BODY in jsdom; the support draft itself was correctly retained.
findings.consequence: Keyboard position can be lost after a meaningful action, even though data is safe.
findings.evidence: Executed DOM component; no browser Tab/AT claim
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: unadded consumer provider and CDS choices survive scalar edits and unrelated support refresh

findings.title: Strict filters remove boundary dependencies
findings.observation: Network A filtering retained Caller and Reporting but hid Caller → Identity on B, including its CDS route. Filtering to Caller's provider organization retained Caller with zero visible dependencies.
findings.consequence: A user trying to understand connections can hide the very relationships they need to inspect.
current_evidence: e2e/connected-focus.spec.ts: network focus preserves complete routes, full marking and return context at 1600px and 1024px

findings.title: Chain highlighting cannot ask a narrow directional question
findings.observation: A chain contains both complete upstream and downstream walks. It correctly avoids pulling in another consumer merely because it shares a provider.
findings.consequence: There is no direct-only Depends on or Used by view with deliberate expansion.
current_evidence: src/map/focus.test.ts: direct/expand/cycle cases; e2e/connected-focus.spec.ts: directional focus expands explicitly without data writes or position changes

findings.title: Foundational visibility summary can contradict the graph
findings.observation: With the toggle off and a selected chain, real headless Cytoscape showed one foundational dependency while the summary counted both foundational dependencies as hidden.
findings.consequence: The text description can disagree with the visible highlight.
findings.evidence: Executed graph + headless Cytoscape; no screenshot
findings.current_source: src/map/map-view.ts: actual visible logical dependency count; src/map/graph.ts: summarize
current_evidence: src/map/graph.test.ts: reports actual hidden foundational dependencies when a chain reveals a normally hidden route

findings.title: Export feedback is visually hidden
findings.observation: PNG/SVG success and error text is written to a sr-only status paragraph. Progress is indicated only by disabled buttons with unchanged labels.
findings.consequence: A failed export can leave a sighted user with only a re-enabled button and no visible explanation.
findings.current_source: src/map/map-view.ts: visible export status and aria-busy
current_evidence: e2e/map.spec.ts: held capture progress; e2e/connected-focus.spec.ts: cancellation and rendering failure

findings.title: The workspace cannot focus the active task
findings.observation: The grid reserves 260px for the list and 340px for details, with no responsive breakpoint or editor collapse. Apply/Discard sit above all service relationships and are not sticky.
findings.consequence: Long relationship work and map work compete for fixed space; applying requires leaving the active lower section.
findings.evidence: Source and width arithmetic; no browser geometry claim
findings.scope: Supporting polish, not a fourth major feature
findings.current_source: src/ui/workspace.ts: Focus editor; src/ui/app.css: responsive form/actions
current_evidence: e2e/connected-focus.spec.ts: keyboard editor focus keeps Apply reachable at laptop width and restores the map

findings.title: A warning acknowledgement can outlive its support-note payload
findings.observation: The executed editor warned about first.example.mil; after changing the support note to second.example.mil, Save anyway stored the changed value under the old visible warning.
findings.consequence: The confirmation no longer describes the exact content being applied.
findings.current_source: src/ui/editor-panel.ts: full exact draft signature; src/domain/repository.ts: aggregate finding collection
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: changed support note cannot reuse an old sensitive acknowledgement; src/domain/initial-service.test.ts: all changed scalar/support findings

findings.title: Diagnostics do not lead to the affected object
findings.observation: Delete blockers and scenario diagnostics are text. Scenario rows have Remove only; Open scenario carries no specific change ID. Import note classes cap visible detail at 50, close after Import, and leave a count summary; open-file issues expose only three witnesses.
findings.consequence: A correct refusal still sends the user to manually locate and repair its cause.
findings.scope: R1 first; full issue review later
findings.current_source: src/domain/errors.ts: typed diagnostic targets; src/ui/editor-panel.ts; src/ui/scenario-changes.ts
current_evidence: e2e/route-diagnostics.spec.ts; e2e/delete-consequences.spec.ts; e2e/scenario-builder.spec.ts

findings.title: Guidance does not reflect the actual starting state
findings.observation: Closing details in a populated fixture still showed Create first network. The header exposes nine actions and SQLite version but no in-app help surface. Literal template examples are not a self-contained sample import.
findings.consequence: The user must learn record order, terminology and repair paths from outside the task.
findings.scope: Small guidance fixes; sample bundle later
findings.current_source: src/ui/editor-panel.ts: initial guidance derived from actual networks
current_evidence: e2e/connected-navigation.spec.ts: existing-network guidance and normalized unchanged Apply preserve the saved checkpoint

findings.title: Success, cancellation and failure share danger styling
findings.observation: Every dataset-message uses the danger color, including successful import and neutral save/download messages.
findings.consequence: Status severity is harder to distinguish at a glance.
findings.current_source: src/main.ts: explicit outcome severity; src/ui/editor-panel.ts: neutral success
current_evidence: e2e/dataset-file.spec.ts: invalid dataset error severity; e2e/session-import-journeys.spec.ts: import neutral severity; e2e/entry-ui.spec.ts: success not error

findings.title: An unadded selection is not a draft relation
findings.observation: Choosing a consumer/dependency option does not add it; a separate Add action does. Any relation change rebuilds those controls, resetting other unadded selections.
findings.consequence: A user can mistake a selected option for a staged connection or lose the choice while editing another relation.
findings.current_source: src/ui/editor-panel.ts: independent unadded picks retained across render
current_evidence: e2e/connected-editor.spec.ts: unadded consumer provider and CDS choices survive scalar edits and unrelated support refresh; picks remain uncommitted until Add

assessment: Original historical observations retained verbatim. Receiving editor/map/repository blobs matched the pin. Current dispositions identify the implementation and exact assertions; execution outcomes are in EXECUTION-STATUS.json and TEST-RESULTS.md. Strict filters remain strict and unadded picks remain pending by design.
